comment: masks publishes two properties RFC 8414 does not register: 'tenant', which carries tenant identity so a consumer reads a claim instead of calling back, and 'resource_indicators_supported'. Both are additive and ignorable by a spec-conformant RP.

The 'tenant' claim is deliberate and is the reason a consumer never has to call back to learn which tenant answered. It is additive, it is documented in discovery, and a client that does not know it ignores it.

A manual step: the suite asks a human to upload a screenshot of the second login page. Every automated condition in this module passes, auth_time included, so what is unproven here is only the screenshot. It cannot be satisfied headlessly and is not a masks defect.

Same manual screenshot step as oidcc-prompt-login. CheckIdTokenAuthTimeClaimPresentDueToMaxAge, CheckSecondIdTokenAuthTimeIsLaterIfPresent and CheckIdTokenAuthTimeIsRecentIfPresent all pass, which is the whole of what max_age is meant to do.
A manual screenshot step. The page itself is now real HTML carrying #authorize-error, which the browser config waits for, rather than the JSON body a person could not act on.
Same manual screenshot step as oidcc-ensure-registered-redirect-uri.
